character.name:
A brutal swamp ogre known as the Bogmaw Crusher.
A massive green-skinned ogre with a thick muscular build, covered in scars, mud, and patches of moss growing directly on its skin. Its posture is hunched forward slightly, giving it a heavy intimidating silhouette. One tusk is broken while the other protrudes upward from its lower jaw.
The ogre wears crude armor assembled from scavenged materials:


Rusted iron shoulder plates


Leather straps stitched together with rope


Fur pelts from swamp beasts


Bone charms hanging from the belt


Its weapon is a gigantic wooden club reinforced with iron spikes and wrapped in old chains. The club looks absurdly heavy, with dried mud and blood stains caked into the wood.
The ogre’s face is rough and expressive:


Small glowing yellow eyes


Flattened nose


Huge jaw with protruding tusks


Constant angry scowl


Additional details:


Swamp plants and fungi growing on parts of the armor


One arm wrapped in dirty bandages


Heavy boots sinking slightly into the ground


Breath visible as toxic green mist


Idle animation ideas:


Slow heavy breathing


Flies buzzing around


Club dragging slightly across the ground


Occasional snort releasing swamp vapor


Color palette:


Dark swamp green skin


Mud brown


Rusted iron orange


Dirty fur gray


Sickly yellow eyes


Style:


Classic fantasy ogre


Heavy readable silhouette for pixel art


Fits an action RPG or old-school hack-and-slash game
